summary: FileGator is a self-hosted web-based file manager (PHP+Flysystem backend, Vue frontend): it authenticates users against a persisted user store (JSON file or SQL users table), scopes each session to a per-user home directory, and exposes a FileController API to browse, create, copy, move, rename, zip/unzip, chmod, delete and edit files/directories in that namespace, plus admin CRUD on user accounts and chunked upload/download/batch-download.
